Range 0...<Pdu Lengthmax> -- Zero - based integer number The size of this global type depends on the maximum length of PDUs to be sent by an ECU. This parameter shall be generated by the generator tool depending on the value configured in Ecu C virtual layer. Available via Com Stack_ Types.h
